_description: Search terms for the job mail the daily run reads (Step 0.5 and Step 1d-2). They copy the six job-mail forwarding filters on the job account, read from its Gmail settings on 2026-11-07, so a search of the job account reaches the same mail the forwarding does. job_mail.py builds every query from this file. No email address of Aneesh's goes here; those live in local_config.json.
_note_matching: Gmail matches a from: term against the sender address and its domain, and a subject: term as a phrase. job_mail.py's local matcher (used only by the shadow compare) approximates that with case-insensitive substring checks.
_note_linkedin_application: LinkedIn Easy Apply notices. 'was sent to' is the receipt; 'Your application to <title> at <company>' is a status update whose links name the page type (email_jobs_application_rejected_01 on 2026-10-15). 'was viewed by' is left out on purpose: it is not a receipt or an outcome.
